main_body: A flat desert sand ground patch (4x3 tiles) with scattered speckles. It is not a standing object.
top_band: none: seamless top-down ground texture with no top/front split, so the 3/4 contract does not apply
evidence: The image is a terrain tile of sand with speckle noise. No standing volume, side face or elevation is drawn. A flat top-down ground fill is the correct representation for this terrain kind, so the 3/4 rules for standing objects do not penalise it.

style.flat_fills_note: no flat area of 5x5 or more; the base tan is broken up by speckles
style.evidence: Sand uses about 5 tones: cream highlight, light tan, base tan, mid ochre and dark brown dots. It has no outlines, which suits ground. Speckles and short highlight dashes give grain throughout, so there are no flat fills. The 16px pattern repeats visibly, and the tiles carry slightly fewer colours and less variety than the grass and paving references. It is still acceptable next to them.
